meta.need_measure: housing_gap_units from the ranking index: the deficit of homes affordable at ≤30% AMI (HUD CHAS).
meta.coverage_measure: LIHTC units awarded in the window (restricted units where the report prints them, else total units) per 100 households in the ≤30% AMI gap. LIHTC mostly serves 60% AMI, so this is a scale comparison, not a claim that each unit closes a ≤30% gap.
meta.quadrant_method: Counties split at the median of need per 1,000 residents (17.3) and of LIHTC units per 100 gap households (11.2).
meta.flag_method: high-vacancy: active-market vacancy (ACS B25004 for-rent plus for-sale-only, over all units) at or above the county 75th percentile, 2.4%. building-ahead: permits over the last five years at least 2× DOLA's projected annual household growth. Flags describe the market; they are not a judgment that any project was wasted.
meta.credit_note: Credit amounts are the ANNUAL credit CHFA awards (claimed over 10 years federally); Prop 123 amounts are dollars awarded, or requested where a preliminary selection list prints only the request.
